title: DashboardLearningEvent
description: The learning event (bahuvani-progress-service, AGB-1067 section 6): one append-only record of what a student or a parent did. `LearningEvent` is a union discriminated by `kind`; each kind has its own `detail` shape.

EventRoundComplete.title: EventRoundComplete

eventId.description: Client-made UUID, or mig-{subjectId}-{knowledgeId}-{sectionId} for imported reading events. Idempotency key within a profile.

profileId.description: The student's subject id. Must equal the token's profile, otherwise EVENT_INVALID.

sectionsTotal.description: Total number of sections in the chapter (sectionsRead is the number read this round). The server checks the reading half itself: the round counts as complete only when at least this many distinct sections were read, otherwise the event is ignored and counted.

practiceTotal.description: Total number of practice questions in the chapter (0 when none). Recorded; the practice half is verified by the server once the chapter's practice count is known. Deployment order: publish contracts, then upgrade the progress service to 2.21, then ship an app that sends practiceTotal. The app must not send practiceTotal to a service still on 2.20 (it rejects the event, EVENT_INVALID).

EventRoundComplete.description: A `round-complete` event. Who may send it: the student actor only (`actor` = student, with the student's own token). The server verifies the claim (sections read, and practice when known) and ignores and counts a round-complete from any other actor or that fails the check; a parent or the system never completes a round for the child.

EventNote.title: EventNote

eventId.description: Client-made UUID, or mig-{subjectId}-{knowledgeId}-{sectionId} for imported reading events. Idempotency key within a profile.

profileId.description: The student's subject id. Must equal the token's profile, otherwise EVENT_INVALID.

quoteOffset.description: Added in 2.23.0. Character offset of `quote` inside the block text (0 or more), so the pin survives a style or language switch and the editor can reopen at the exact place. Sent on `create` and `edit` only; the service ignores it on `delete`. Optional: a 2.22 event without it is unchanged. If the block is missing, the app falls to the nearest block with a notice.

redacted.description: Added in 2.23.0. SET BY THE SERVER ONLY: a deleted note's `text` and `quote` were blanked (redaction) and this marks the event. It appears on events read back through `/changes` and export so they still validate against `LearningEvent`. A client must never send it: intake refuses it with an explicit check after schema validation, on both `/events` and `/events/parent` (the schema allows the field only because server-written events carry it). A create carrying it is a blank shell of a deleted note (tombstone).

categoryId.description: Added in 2.29.0 (AGB-1187). The learner's custom category (the id of a `note-category`). Optional, on `create` and `edit`. On `edit`: absent means unchanged, a string sets the category, `null` clears it (back to the base `tag`); a `tag` alone never clears a category. `tag` stays one of the five built-in values and is the base tag an older app or service shows. Never sent while the service does not advertise the `note-categories` capability (an older service refuses it as skew).

EventNote.description: A `note` event. 2.23.0 adds the optional `quoteOffset` (create and edit) and the server-set, read-only `redacted: true`; no new actions and no new actors. 2.29.0 adds the optional `categoryId` (create and edit).

EventActivityDone.title: EventActivityDone

eventId.description: Client-made UUID. Idempotency key within a profile: sending the same eventId again is a `duplicate`, never a second completion.

profileId.description: The student's subject id. Must equal the token's profile, otherwise EVENT_INVALID.

round.description: Required for this kind: the learning round the parent confirmed it in.

sectionId.description: Required for this kind: the section the activity deepens (the activity's `deepens`).

actor.description: Parent actor only. The progress service refuses this kind from a student actor or a student token (the same rule it applies to teach-back and review-done). The child cannot confirm.

languages.description: Optional: the language(s) the family used for the activity. Never free text.

EventActivityDone.description: An `activity-done` event (2.22.0, AGB-1099): the parent confirms the family did a home activity ("We did it", behind the parent gate). Rules: PARENT actor only (`actor` is the constant `parent`; the server also refuses a student token); ids only, no photo, no free text and no field about the child (additionalProperties is false); idempotent by `eventId`; `sectionId` and `round` are required. The date is the event's `at`. A mistaken tap is fixed with a `correction` event. PLANNED: the progress service up to 2.21 rejects this kind (EVENT_INVALID); rules v1.1 will count it as step 6 evidence once the child is at step 4 or more, and the server will check `activityId` against the chapter context. Deployment order: publish contracts, then upgrade the progress service to 2.22, then ship an app that sends it. The progress service up to 2.21 rejects an unknown detail field (EVENT_INVALID). From 2.22 the schema accepts it; whether the service reads it is stated per field.

replacement.description: PLANNED: not applied by the service yet (it only voids events), but accepted at intake. Optional corrected detail values for the event named by correctsEventId. `targetKind` is the kind of that event (any kind except `correction`) and must equal the real kind of the corrected event (checked by the server, not by this schema); `detail` holds only fields that the kind's own `detail` allows, and only the fields to change (the others keep their value). A field the target kind does not allow is rejected. Without `replacement` the correction voids the event.

text.description: The child's own question words, shown to the parent; repeats of the same question show confusion.

redacted.description: Added in 2.23.0. SET BY THE SERVER ONLY: this correction targets a note that was deleted, so its `reason` and `replacement.detail.text` / `quote` were blanked (redaction, TA D18). Intake refuses it from a client, like `redacted` on a note event. Because `reason` is removed, `reason` is required only when `redacted` is absent (a 2.22 correction always has it).

EventCorrection.description: A `correction` event. Rules the progress service applies today: (1) it may only name an earlier event of the same profile (lower seq). (2) A student may not correct a read, listen, revisit, round-start or round-complete event (the correction is ignored and counted: a child cannot lower their own furthest point or round progress); any other kind may be corrected by anyone with access. (3) Chains: corrections are judged from the latest seq down. A correction is active unless a later active correction names it, so correcting a correction restores the original and correcting that voids it again. Arrival order never matters. An active correction voids the named event for derived state (the original stays in the log). PLANNED, not applied by the service yet (it only voids): a narrower per-actor rule (a student may correct only answer, reveal, self-check, note and buddy-question; teach-back, revision and review-done only by a parent), and `replacement` (below); when applied, the active correction with the highest seq naming an event decides its detail, with no merging of several corrections.

EventNoteCategory.title: EventNoteCategory

eventId.description: Client-made UUID, or mig-{subjectId}-{knowledgeId}-{sectionId} for imported reading events. Idempotency key within a profile.

profileId.description: The student's subject id. Must equal the token's profile, otherwise EVENT_INVALID.

name.description: The category name (1 to 100 characters, counted as code points by the validator). Required on `create` and `rename` (service rule, not schema). The real limit is the name rule of the service: 1 to 24 characters not counting combining marks, so the schema allows up to 100 characters. A blanked or alias event carries no `name`. A name is personal data: never log it.

aliasOf.description: SET BY THE SERVER ONLY: a `create` whose normalised name equals a live category is stored with `aliasOf` = the existing category id and no `name`; every note carrying this event's `categoryId` then resolves to the existing category. A client must never send it: intake refuses it.

redacted.description: SET BY THE SERVER ONLY: the `name` of a deleted category was blanked (redaction). Appears on events read back through `/changes` and the learner's own export so they still validate. A client must never send it: intake refuses it on both routes.

EventNoteCategory.description: A `note-category` event (2.29.0, AGB-1187): a learner creates, renames or deletes one of their own note categories. Student actor only (a guarded child's student token or a self learner's adult token), never on `/events/parent`. Private to the learner: never visible to a guardian (a guardian sees only the plain-text label on a note). No `knowledgeId`, `sectionId` or `blockId`. Send only when `GET /learners/me/status` lists the `note-categories` capability. Privacy (2.29.0): a guardian NEVER receives a `note-category` or `saved-idea` event on any path, and NEVER receives `categoryId`: the service strips it from note events and notes on guardian paths and refuses `categoryId` on a parent-actor note event.

EventSavedIdea.title: EventSavedIdea

eventId.description: Client-made UUID, or mig-{subjectId}-{knowledgeId}-{sectionId} for imported reading events. Idempotency key within a profile.

profileId.description: The student's subject id. Must equal the token's profile, otherwise EVENT_INVALID.

ideaId.description: The Study Jam line id. Unique within its section, so the key of a saved idea is (`knowledgeId`, `sectionId`, `ideaId`).

text.description: A copy of the saved line (1 to 600 characters). Required on `save`, ignored on `remove`.

who.description: The speaker's display name (1 to 60 characters). Required on `save`, ignored on `remove`.

redacted.description: SET BY THE SERVER ONLY. A client must never send it: intake refuses it on both routes.

EventSavedIdea.description: A `saved-idea` event (2.29.0, AGB-1188): a learner saves or removes a Study Jam line as a bookmark. Student actor only, never on `/events/parent`, and learner-only: never visible to a guardian on any path. `knowledgeId` and `sectionId` (the Study Jam section id) are required, `style` is `study-jam`, `language` as the player sends it; neither is part of the key and the first save wins. Never sent with an empty section id. Send only when the `saved-ideas` capability is listed. Privacy (2.29.0): a guardian NEVER receives a `note-category` or `saved-idea` event on any path, and NEVER receives `categoryId`: the service strips it from note events and notes on guardian paths and refuses `categoryId` on a parent-actor note event.
